[LIMP.7.7] An importer that references a name not declared
at the imported library's top level is rejected with
`DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_IMPORT_NAME` naming the import line and
the missing identifier. The diagnostic carries a hint listing
the lookup tables the precedence walk consulted (schema /
const / rule / domain / flat-service / unit / unit formula) so
authors can tell whether the name should have been a different
decl kind.

A unit and a `unit formula` ([LUNI.4.5]) are top-level declarations an
importer may name. A formula is imported by its formula name, which brings
both of its functions; a function name alone is not an importable name.
